extraction.name: Video-MME
extraction.description: The first-ever full-spectrum, Multi-Modal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis. It encompasses 900 videos across 6 primary visual domains with 30 subfields, ranging from 11 seconds to 1 hour, and integrates multi-modal inputs including subtitles and audios, with 2,700 high-quality multiple-choice questions.
extraction.creator: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The construction of the Video-MME dataset involves three main steps: video collection, question-answer annotation, and quality review. A domain hierarchy was established for sourcing raw videos from YouTube across 6 key domains and 30 finely-grained categories. Videos with varying duration lengths were collected along with corresponding meta-information such as subtitles and audios.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw videos sourced from YouTube, including corresponding meta-information such as subtitles (if provided) and audios.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Text-only questions were provided to Gemini 1.5 Pro to filter out QA pairs that could be answered solely based on the textual questions without needing the video content.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators thoroughly viewed the entire video, then iteratively created three relevant questions, each accompanied by four candidate options in a multiple-choice QA format. Each QA pair was designed to be closely tied to the video content.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Each QA pair underwent examination by a different annotator to verify clear language expression, answerability, logically consistent candidate options, and appropriate correct answers. Additionally, Gemini 1.5 Pro was used to filter out questions that did not strictly require video content to answer.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Annotators with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language learning.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Testing and evaluating the compositional video understanding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).
